title: A schema step's grade is keyed on the dialect alone, and never on the server version the connection already has.
text: `rule:core-classes/schema-plan` keys a grade on driver **and** server version, and grades up only when the version is unknown. `grade_of` at `crates/nvs-db/src/ddl.rs:982` takes the dialect and nothing else, so adding a column with a default is always graded as a rewrite, even on PostgreSQL 11+ and MySQL 8.0.12+. `Connection::server_version` at `crates/nvs-db/src/conn.rs:1142` holds the version a plan built over a connection could pass in. Closing this threads an optional server version into `grade_of`, grades the version-keyed changes from it, keeps grading up when it is absent, and tests both arms.
